_comment: Cleft (riven) slate: a fine-grained, dark blue-grey metamorphic stone split along its cleavage, so its face is a set of shallow, ragged terraces with a faint ripple and the odd rusty iron stain: a roofing or flooring slate as split, not honed. Opaque: a solid, dull dielectric. Base textures are generated (L2, tools/converters/base/gen_slate_cleft.py), not scanned: ambientCG has no asset that names slate as a stone surface (only slate roofing tiles, an assembly, and a gravel), and the library names only what a source states. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): edge wear (overlay 1, damage) and dust as a deposit (Phase10), gated by the Crevice mask. Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: Slate_Cleft_Clean_Base_s1_v01

sources.why: Mean linear albedo (0.065, 0.072, 0.085), about sRGB 72, 76, 82, for a dark blue-grey roofing slate; roughness about 0.63 for a split face with a faint mica sheen; specular_ior 1.55 for slate's mica, chlorite and quartz (about 1.54-1.6). Physically Based has no slate entry.
